notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay improvements.
notes.content:
[h1] Hungrities 1.2.0 [/h1]
[h1]In this patch, the following points have been fixed, modified, and added:[/h1]

[b]Bug fix:[/b] Resolved an issue when attempting to capture a creature in the presence of many on the map.

[b]Modification[/b] of in-game volume and specific audio elements.

[b]Modification of creature damage[/b] dealt by creatures, and adjustment of damage received by creatures when the negative night event is active.

[b]Modification[/b] of the button to access the creature collection.

[b]Implementation[/b] of a credits menu upon game launch.

[i]Alexisy[/i]
